authority: Prepare for review only; no initialization, account provisioning or key generation authorized.
composition: This file freezes migration-phase catalogs and administrator/key proposals. The portable-baseline file freezes POST-LEDGER geography/reference/demo projections; its rows replace same-named projections here only after the full 229-file ledger. Additional currencies are post-ledger, not part of the first checkpoint. Empty geography below refers only to migration checkpoints, never the proposed final baseline. All files remain approval-gated.
hash_recipe: Relative path, one SPACE, lowercase SHA256 of bytes; filename-sorted entries joined by LF without trailing LF. Migration receipt uses basenames. Execution receipt covers app, config, bootstrap excluding cache directories, database/migrations, database/seeders, routes, composer.json and composer.lock; symlinks are forbidden.

checkpoints.name: portable_reference_and_demo_proposal
initialize: Approved post-ledger tables/rows in local-synthetic-portable-baseline.json; blog rows only after separate admin approval
checkpoints.require: Restore intended portable geography/categories/demo catalog via explicit reviewed rows, not country observers/default-role backfills. Verify exact 29 non-login demo identities/role links, non-financial shop grants, zero country/Spatie Finance grants, no Wallet or money activity, and approved portable asset availability.

row_policy.initialization: Insert exact approved rows only into independently empty reviewed table/key ranges at the listed checkpoints; no updateOrCreate by fixed ID, ambient observers or ordinary seeder invocation. Preserve intended geography and portable demo through the separately frozen post-ledger baseline.
row_policy.idempotency: Second reference invocation verifies exact rows without writes, timestamp changes, auto-increment changes or migration replay; any mismatch fails closed.
row_policy.timestamps: Where required, record actual first-write timestamps in the private receipt and preserve them exactly on retry. Country Finance definitions retain native migration NULL timestamps.
row_policy.defaults: All unspecified schema defaults and nullable columns must also be captured in the full native row receipt; counts and the projections below alone are not proof.

native_finance_definitions.country_rows: Append in key order: IDs 24..35, group=payments, label=ucwords(str_replace('.', ' ', key)), created_at=NULL, updated_at=NULL.
native_finance_definitions.spatie_rows: IDs 1..12 in key order, name=key, guard_name=web; retain native first-write timestamps.

template_definitions.reason: Native required email_setting_id FK and provisioners require an active email provider; no fake provider, SMTP configuration or FK weakening.

administrator_proposal.password_policy: Owner supplies an independent random password through secure tooling after approval; native bcrypt with rounds=10; no fallback or demo password, no plaintext/hash in evidence.
administrator_proposal.email_verification: Owner-authorized local synthetic attestation only, timestamp retained privately; no verification email or reuse for a real identity.
administrator_proposal.creation_contract: Separate explicit provisioning transaction after native reference/demo receipt and independent owner approval. Use native User observer contract; inventory its zero-value user_points and model-log side effects. Persist exact generated UUID/referral privately. Add one model_has_roles row (role_id=99, model_type=App\\Models\\User, model_id=1) to the 29 separately approved non-login demo links; all country/Spatie Finance permission grants still empty. Blog author rows may follow only after this approval/proof.
administrator_proposal.retry_contract: Verify existing exact identity, bcrypt and intended role without rewriting password, UUID, referrals or timestamps; mismatch stops, never adopt an unrelated account.
administrator_proposal.recovery: No second default account; owner-controlled independent key escrow and explicit local recovery procedure, never automatic password reset or challenge dispatch.

key_custody_proposal.generation: Secure-tooling-only independent cryptographic generation: 32 random bytes for Laravel AES-256-CBC app key and a separate 32-byte recovery encryption key. Neither derives from SESSION_SECRET, normal configuration, staging authority or demo material.
key_custody_proposal.custody: Owner must approve the secure generation/escrow tool and custody location first. No values in code, chat, argv, URLs, stdout, logs, Git or evidence. Record only non-secret version IDs and pass/fail checks.
key_custody_proposal.proof: Owner retains an independent escrow copy outside the lab; in an isolated process prove Laravel ciphertext decrypts with the retained same-version key and fails with a different key. No business payload encryption, provider revision creation or financial action.
key_custody_proposal.local_limit: Same-host Secrets/files alone are not independent off-host production disaster recovery; real backup destination, retention and RPO/RTO remain separately gated.

prohibited: Existing or partial schema repair, migrate:fresh, financial down(), ledger fabrication
Unreviewed demo content, runtime Orders/Bookings/Carts, any Wallet or financial movement; intended portable Shops/Products/Services require explicit baseline approval
Electronic provider definitions, credentials, profiles, revisions or activation
SMTP providers, queued delivery, challenge dispatch, workers or scheduler activation
Automatic financial grants, country owner/staff memberships or all-permissions roles
Imported normal/staging/demo passwords, keys, datasets or configuration
Normal database writes, VPS access, production identities/defaults/keys or release

product_media_owner_decision.scope: Only post-ledger Product/Stock img=NULL and omission of 13 Product Gallery rows; migration checkpoints and all reference definitions unchanged.
